text: ui-view `ac-list` (2.1.28, unchanged in substance since 2.1.27) says the row's `title` is cut to ~40 characters with an ellipsis on one line — the chip rule (2348dsll) — and that at most 3 tag chips show, the rest as "+N more". The code does neither: the title is a one-line CSS clamp with no 40-character cut (a code comment says the list page IS the criteria, so it is deliberately not cut to the chip length), and the kit `EntityListRow` renders every tag chip with no "+N more" overflow (its record has no such limit). The unit's goal keeps the screens' behaviour as before apart from what the changed components bring, so only the composition changed in this window: the `kind` badge and the deprecated-only status badge are now kit `Badge`s. Needs: either the record drops the 40-character cut and the 3-chip limit, or a follow-up unit builds them (the 3-chip limit would belong in the `entity-list-row` record).
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-2812 — the AC list row keeps its one-line title clamp and shows all tag chips; only the kind/status badges moved to the kit Badge.
